title: Damage Nights on the Listings Minimum Stay — HostCover Property-Damage Schedule
content:
# Damage Nights on the Minimum Stay

*Schedule for Roamhaven Listings, read against the listing's Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims.*

Party-prevention nights sit on top of the standard minimum-stay floor and are worked out on the day of the change. **Damage nights** are read from the Host Damage Protection (HostCover) claims in the property damage category that the claims team approved and that were filed on the listing within the last twelve months, counted from the date part of the filing moment:

| Approved property-damage HostCover claims filed on the listing within the last twelve months | Damage nights |
|---|---|
| 2 or more | 2 nights |
| exactly 1 | 1 night |
| none | none |

## Counting notes

- Only approved claims count; submitted, escalated, denied or withdrawn claims do not.
- Only the property damage category counts; pet-damage, deep-cleaning, theft, valuables and income-loss claims do not.
- Only claims filed on this listing count.

## Cases (hypothetical claim histories)

| Claims on the listing | Damage nights |
|---|---|
| 2 approved property-damage claims filed four and nine months ago | 2 nights |
| 1 approved property-damage claim filed seven months ago, 1 denied | 1 night |
| 1 approved pet-damage claim filed two months ago | none |
